court: In the High Court of Madras
respondents: Pereira and Roche Private Limited and Others … Respondent(s).
prayer: Prayer: Civil Miscellaneous appeal filed under Section 10-F of the Companies Act, 1956, praying to set aside the order of the Company Law Board, Southern Region Bench, Chennai in C.P. No. 1/111/SRB/2001 and allow the above Appeal.
judgment_text:
1. The Civil Miscellaneous appeal has been filed to set aside the order of the Company Law Board, Southern Region Bench, Chennai in C.P. No. 1/111/SRB/2001.

2. The learned counsel appearing for the appellant had placed on record a screenshot from the website of the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, which indicates the first respondent company had been struck off from the Register.

3. In view of the same, there is no useful purpose in adjudicating the lis involved in this Civil Miscellaneous Appeal.

4. Accordingly, this Civil Miscellaneous appeal stands closed. No costs.
